distribution.summary: 重庆；广东；海南；云南；香港；台湾
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Chongqing, Guangdong, Hainan, Yunnan, Hong Kong and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently accepts Taiwan occurrence, with records from Nantou and Taichung. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: Broussonetia is retained at genus level from Smith et al. (2020). Beaver & Liu (2010) describes the species as strongly polyphagous but enumerates no host taxon in the curated field; no additional host is promoted.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Euwallacea similis (Ferrari, 1867).
